gtcrn_worker.graph_recurrent_state_limitation: gtcrn_model.onnx has no exposed recurrent state inputs or outputs. Frame-by-frame invocation (T=1) reinitializes internal GRU states to zeros on each call. Frame-by-frame streaming with persistent recurrent states requires either the Python GTCRNStreamAdapter or an re-exported ONNX graph with explicit h_in / h_out state tensors. This remains a documented invariant for future embedded deployment.
